name: Patient Intake Coordinator (Avery)
_notes: Model is Google gemini-2.5-flash via Vapi: cheapest high-quality option with low latency and reliable function calling (needed for the save_patient/lookup_patient tools). Chosen over DeepSeek/GPT-5-nano which are cheaper per token but less reliable at multi-step tool calling in real-time voice. Swappable in the dashboard. The system prompt is the single source of truth in vapi/system-prompt.md, injected by vapi/build_assistant.py. Server URL and secret are injected from env at build time. No real secrets live in this file.
firstMessage: Hi, thanks for calling! I'm Avery, and I'll get you registered as a new patient. It only takes a couple of minutes. To start, what's the best phone number to reach you?

function.name: lookup_patient
function.description: Check whether an existing patient record matches a phone number, for duplicate detection with returning callers. Call this early, right after collecting the phone number.

phone_number.description: US 10-digit phone number to look up. Digits only or common formatting; e.g. 5551234567.

function.name: save_patient
function.description: Validate and persist a new patient after the caller has confirmed all details. Pass every collected field. On a validation problem the response names the specific field to re-prompt (read it to the caller and re-ask only that field); on success the response confirms the registration.

first_name.description: Patient's first name. 1-50 characters; letters, hyphens, and apostrophes only.

last_name.description: Patient's last name. 1-50 characters; letters, hyphens, and apostrophes only.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g. 03/05/1990). Must not be in the future.

sex.description: Patient's sex. Exactly one of the allowed values.

phone_number.description: US 10-digit phone number. Digits only or common formatting; e.g. 5551234567.

state.description: 2-letter US state abbreviation (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

zip_code.description: US ZIP code: 5 digits or ZIP+4 (e.g. 94105 or 94105-1234).

email.description: Optional email address. Must be a valid email if provided.

address_line_2.description: Optional address line 2 (apartment, suite, or unit).

preferred_language.description: Optional preferred language. Defaults to English if not provided.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional emergency contact US 10-digit phone number.
